title: Humble Beginnings.
caption: Born on a stormy monsoon night, the midwife reportedly declared, “This one will run the country.”

title: The Debating Champion.
caption: At eleven, he won the district debate by arguing that homework was unconstitutional. He lost the argument but won the crowd.

title: University Years.
caption: Studied everything and nothing, graduating top of a class he technically founded.

title: The First Venture.
caption: Launched a start-up that solved a problem nobody had, and somehow it worked.

title: Into Public Life.
caption: The people noticed. The people approved. The people made t-shirts.

title: Elected President.
caption: In a landslide of historic proportions, a nation chose its champion. History was made.
